summary: KB Editor Overhaul - Frontend Testing Complete. All 10 features tested and verified working. The editor properly shows Meta Title/Meta Description labels, visual cards in 3-column grid, slash command menu with Basic/Layout/Components groups, Insert dropdown, Heading dropdown (Paragraph + H1-H6), and Edit Card Attributes popup. No critical console errors found (only known TipTap flushSync warnings).

issues: TipTap flushSync warnings appear during editor interactions - known React/TipTap issue, does not affect functionality
TipTap duplicate extension warning for 'link' and 'underline' - cosmetic only

context_for_next_testing_agent: KB Editor at /dashboard/kb-editor. Auth uses session_token=test_kb_session_token cookie. Welcome article has 9 visual cards in 3-col grid. Slash command triggered by typing '/'. Key data-testids: kb-editor-page, editor-toolbar, insert-btn, insert-menu, heading-dropdown, heading-menu, slash-command-menu, columns-block, columns-grid, columns-settings-btn, columns-settings-popup, column-card, card-visual, card-settings-popup, card-edit-title/description/icon/url/image/cta/horizontal, card-save-btn, editor-title-input, editor-description-input.

slug_field.details: Slug field visible with preview URL showing /docs/{slug}

category_field.details: Category dropdown with nav groups, Subcategory also available

visual_cards_3col_grid.details: Welcome article loads with 9 visual cards in 3-column grid layout (data-cols='3')

card_edit_popup.details: Clicking card opens 'Edit Card Attributes' popup with: Title, Description, Icon, URL, Image Path, Call To Action fields, Horizontal toggle, Save Changes button, Delete button

slash_command_menu.details: Typing '/' opens floating menu with 19 items in 3 groups: Basic (Paragraph, Heading 1-3, lists, blockquote, code, divider), Layout (2 Columns, 3 Columns), Components (Card Group, Note/Tip/Warning callouts, Steps, Tabs, Accordion, YouTube)

insert_toolbar_dropdown.details: Insert button opens dropdown with: Note/Tip/Warning Callouts, Steps, Tabs, Accordion, YouTube Video, 2 Columns, 3 Columns, Code Block, Horizontal Rule

heading_dropdown.details: Heading dropdown shows Paragraph and Heading 1-6 options, current selection highlighted

edit_columns_button.details: 'Edit Columns' button appears on hover over columns block, opens popup with column count dropdown (One/Two/Three), Save Changes and Delete buttons

visual_vs_code_rendering.details: <Columns> and <Card> markdown components render as visual cards in grid, not code blocks. Non-visual components like <iframe> render as code blocks correctly.

no_critical_console_errors.details: No critical console errors during page load and interactions. Only known TipTap flushSync warnings (cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality)
